title: Laws About Servants and Justice

questions.question: After how many years was a Hebrew servant to go free?
questions.explanation: Exodus 21:2 (ESV): "When you buy a Hebrew slave, he shall serve six years, and in the seventh he shall go out free."

questions.question: What is the penalty for murder in this chapter?
options: The murderer shall be put to death
questions.correctAnswer: The murderer shall be put to death
questions.explanation: Exodus 21:12 (ESV): "Whoever strikes a man so that he dies shall be put to death."

questions.question: What is the penalty for striking one's father or mother?
questions.explanation: Exodus 21:15 (ESV): "Whoever strikes his father or his mother shall be put to death."

questions.question: What famous principle of justice appears in this chapter?
options: Eye for eye, tooth for tooth
questions.correctAnswer: Eye for eye, tooth for tooth
questions.explanation: Exodus 21:24 (ESV): "Eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot."

questions.question: What is the penalty for kidnapping someone?
questions.explanation: Exodus 21:16 (ESV): "Whoever steals a man and sells him, and anyone found in possession of him, shall be put to death."

questions.question: What would a servant do if he loved his master and chose not to go free?
options: His master would bore his ear through with an awl
questions.correctAnswer: His master would bore his ear through with an awl
questions.explanation: Exodus 21:5-6 (ESV): "His master shall bore his ear through with an awl, and he shall be his servant forever."

questions.question: What was the rule if an ox gored someone to death?
options: The ox was to be sold
The ox must be stoned and its flesh not eaten
questions.correctAnswer: The ox must be stoned and its flesh not eaten
questions.explanation: Exodus 21:28 (ESV): "When an ox gores a man or a woman to death, the ox shall be stoned, and its flesh shall not be eaten."

questions.question: What provision was made for cities of refuge?
options: God would appoint a place for accidental killers to flee
questions.correctAnswer: God would appoint a place for accidental killers to flee
questions.explanation: Exodus 21:13 (ESV): "But if he did not lie in wait for him, but God let him fall into his hand, then I will appoint for you a place to which he may flee."

questions.question: What was the penalty for cursing one's father or mother?
questions.explanation: Exodus 21:17 (ESV): "Whoever curses his father or his mother shall be put to death."

questions.question: If two men fought and one was injured but not killed, what was required?
options: The attacker must pay for his lost time and have him healed
questions.correctAnswer: The attacker must pay for his lost time and have him healed
questions.explanation: Exodus 21:19 (ESV): "He shall pay for the loss of his time, and shall have him thoroughly healed."

questions.question: If an owner knew his ox was a habitual gorer and did not restrain it, what happened?
options: The ox would be stoned and its owner also put to death
questions.correctAnswer: The ox would be stoned and its owner also put to death
questions.explanation: Exodus 21:29 (ESV): "If the ox has been accustomed to gore... and its owner has not kept it in... the ox shall be stoned, and its owner also shall be put to death."

questions.question: What could the owner of a habitually goring ox pay instead of death?
options: A ransom for his life, whatever is imposed on him
questions.correctAnswer: A ransom for his life, whatever is imposed on him
questions.explanation: Exodus 21:30 (ESV): "If a ransom is imposed on him, then he shall give for the redemption of his life whatever is imposed on him."

questions.question: What was the penalty if a master knocked out a servant's tooth or eye?
questions.explanation: Exodus 21:26-27 (ESV): "When a man strikes the eye of his slave... and destroys it, he shall let the slave go free because of his eye."

questions.question: What was the penalty if someone opened or dug a pit and an animal fell in?
options: He must make restitution by paying the owner and keeping the dead animal
questions.correctAnswer: He must make restitution by paying the owner and keeping the dead animal
questions.explanation: Exodus 21:33-34 (ESV): "The owner of the pit shall make restoration. He shall give money to its owner, and the dead beast shall be his."

questions.question: If men fought and struck a pregnant woman causing premature birth but no harm, what was the penalty?
options: A fine as the woman's husband demands and the judges determine
questions.correctAnswer: A fine as the woman's husband demands and the judges determine
questions.explanation: Exodus 21:22 (ESV): "He shall pay as the judges determine."

key_verse_text: Eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot.
